description: Write document info fields (title, author, subject, creator, keywords) into a PDF. Give at least one; an empty string sets an empty value. Unicode is fine. Keywords may be a list or a comma-separated string. The output is saved unencrypted. Use pdf_metadata to read the current values. Returns the result inline as an application/pdf resource; the source is never modified.

keywords.description: Comma-separated string or list of keywords

password.description: Password to open the input, only needed for a user-password PDF (owner-locked files with an empty user password open without it).

pdf_path.description: PDF source: an https:// URL or a data:application/pdf;base64,… URI (this hosted server cannot read local file paths).

name: pdf_set_metadata

bytes.description: Size of the produced PDF in bytes

resource_uri.description: pdfops:// uri of the inline application/pdf resource

title: Set PDF metadata
